text:
jessica_support: Started thread — customer ACME Inc. (tenant: acme-42) opened INC-4321. They saw 403s + compliance alerts after degraded performance.

maria_cs: Customer timeline: 2026-03-17 12:02 UTC saw latency spike, requests got rerouted and they received 403s with message "residency-policy-violation".

jessica_support: They attached audit alert we triggered: "policy_exception: data_residency". Can infra take a look? :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4321 created and paged ops-oncall.

tom_infra: I'm on it. pulling router and failover logs now.

tom_infra: snippet from router at 2026-03-17T12:04:14Z:
```
route_id=urn:12345 request_id=req-0ab region_hint=us-west selected_node=eu-central fallback_reason=capacity_throttle policy_flags=[allow-fallback]
```

security_sre: That selected_node=eu-central is bad for acme-42 — their org has residency=us-west only enforced. Why did policy_flags include allow-fallback?

ops_lead: Quick mitigation: set routing policy for tenant acme-42 to strict-residency (prevent cross-region failover). Maria, can you notify customer we applied an emergency change and are exporting audit logs?

maria_cs: Notifying customer now. I'll share the logs once export is ready. ETA 20m.

tom_infra: Repro steps I used:
1) curl -v -H "X-Tenant: acme-42" -H "X-Client-Region: us-west" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health
2) observe header X-Routed-Region: eu-central when gateway is under load

Example response headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-error: residency-policy-violation
x-routed-region: eu-central
```

security_sre: Root cause hypothesis: the routing fallback logic used a generic allow-fallback override for some reserved capacity pools. That override didn't check tenant residency constraints during selection. This passed earlier unit tests but failed at runtime when capacity in us-west saturated.

jessica_support: Ticket INC-4321 escalated to Security + Infra. Customer requesting timeline and exported audit trail for compliance.

ops_lead: Next steps:
- [P0] Keep strict-residency enabled for acme-42 until we patch (done)
- [P1] Hotfix router to evaluate tenant residency before selecting fallback (owner: tom_infra)
- [P2] Add unit + integration test for residency enforcement in failover logic (owner: eng-runtime)
- [P3] Create alert on any cross-region routing for tenants with residency constraints (owner: security_sre)
- [P4] Prepare customer-facing incident report and deliver audit logs (owner: maria_cs)

oncall-bot: Action logged: routing policy change applied to tenant acme-42 by ops_lead at 2026-03-17T12:12:03Z

maria_cs: Customer acknowledgement: "Thanks, please provide full audit export and estimated remediation time." They want timestamped list of requests that hit eu-central.

tom_infra: Exported request index for acme-42 between 12:00–12:10 UTC. Sending to maria now. Will start working on hotfix, ETA 4h.

security_sre: We'll prepare compliance note and adjust runbook. Also recommend a short-term policy: do not allow cross-region fallback for tenants with residency tags unless explicit opt-in.

jessica_support: Adding follow-up: create postmortem once hotfix deployed. Tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-oncall.

ops_lead: Closing loop here — mitigation applied and customer notified. We'll update thread when hotfix is live. :white_check_mark:
